name: PLYTEC
recent: PLYTEC 近期宣布以 RM6.21 million 现金收购雪兰莪 Kuala Langat 一块永久地契空地，并应交易所询问补充资料；同时公司披露董事经理 Yang Kian Lock 在 2026 年 10 月 5 日间接处置 144,728,000 股（占 23.88%），涉及 Prestij Usaha Sdn. Bhd. 的股权变动。公司也更换了公司秘书。
notable: 全资子公司 PFWSI 与 J.P. Lim & Sons Sdn. Bhd. 签署买卖协议，以 RM6,208,127.50 现金收购 Kuala Langat 一块永久地契空地。
董事经理 Yang Kian Lock 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日间接处置 144,728,000 股（23.88%），因其出售 Prestij Usaha Sdn. Bhd. 全部股权而不再被视为对该等股份拥有权益。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 28 日更换公司秘书，Yee Kit Yeng 与 Winnie Goh Kah Mun 接任。
risks: 董事经理 Yang Kian Lock 间接处置 144,728,000 股（23.88%），涉及大股东层面的股权变动。
Bursa Malaysia 于 2026 年 9 月 4 日就拟议土地收购发出询问，公司随后补充资料。

news.title: Plytec seeks up to RM7.52m in facilities for Kuala Langat land deal
Plytec proposes RM6.2mil land acquisition in Selangor

recent_en: PLYTEC recently announced a RM6.21 million cash acquisition of a freehold vacant land in Kuala Langat, Selangor, and provided additional information following a Bursa query. The company also disclosed that Group Managing Director Yang Kian Lock indirectly disposed of 144,728,000 shares (23.88%) on 5 October 2026, involving a change in his interest in Prestij Usaha Sdn. Bhd. The company also changed its company secretary.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary PFWSI signed a sale and purchase agreement with J.P. Lim & Sons Sdn. Bhd. to acquire a freehold vacant land in Kuala Langat for RM6,208,127.50 in cash.

Group Managing Director Yang Kian Lock indirectly disposed of 144,728,000 shares (23.88%) on 5 October 2026 after disposing of his entire stake in Prestij Usaha Sdn. Bhd., ceasing to be deemed interested in those shares.
The company changed its company secretary on 28 August 2026, with Yee Kit Yeng and Winnie Goh Kah Mun appointed.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Yang Kian Lock indirectly disposed of 144,728,000 shares (23.88%), involving a change at the substantial shareholder level.
Bursa Malaysia issued a query on 4 September 2026 regarding the proposed land acquisition, and the company subsequently provided additional information.
